name: v0.13.0
body:
- Your game state is now saved and restored when you come back to it. No more starting from scratch (unless you want to)! https://github.com/adil192/super_nonogram/pull/46
- Added an indicator for the current board width and height. #36 
- Fixed numbers rendering/wrapping incorrectly on some devices. #44 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adil192/super_nonogram/compare/v0.12.1...v0.13.0

name: v0.11.1
body:
- The middle column and row are now highlighted to make counting easier
- Improved contrast between the game board and the background image, for better visibility
- Added a privacy policy link to the search page, for more transparency
- Minor visual tweaks

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adil192/super_nonogram/compare/v0.11.0...v0.11.1

name: v0.11.0
body:
- Added a "classic" game mode which generates random 9x9 boards.
- Increased label sizes so they are easier to read.
- Added haptic feedback to the game board (for Android and iOS only).
- Small UI improvements.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adil192/super_nonogram/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0

name: v0.7.4
body:
- Improved input to prevent gaps when dragging to select tiles
- Improved the settings page
- The title screen is now darker in dark mode

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adil192/super_nonogram/compare/v0.7.3...v0.7.4
- Attribution is now displayed for images from Pixabay

- You can now tap and hold to cross out tiles (or right click on desktop)
- Fixed only the first achievement being awarded on Android
- Fixed the app name on iOS and macOS
- Added a new icon

- Added achievements for completing levels on Android, iOS, and macOS
- If you were installing the APK from GitHub releases, please uninstall it and reinstall through the Play Store.

- Fixed toolbar overlapping the system UI
- Improvements to the board's swipe-to-select gesture
- Fixed the first row and column always being blank when using "Play images"
- Fixed internal files being placed in the Documents directory #1

- You can now cross out tiles on the board
- Centered the settings page on desktop and tablets

- Option to use the Atkinson Hyperlegible font for low vision users
- Added incorrect answer feedback for individual rows and columns
- Added support for more platforms

- Fixed app name on Android
- Fixed web compatibility
- Levels get hard more slowly
- Added an ad to the settings page
- UI improvements

- Fixed a bug where simpler puzzles would be fully/almost automatically solved because full rows/columns are filled at the start of the game.
- The game now remembers which level you're currently on.
- The game now checks to see if you've completed the puzzle.
- Fixed a few places where text is illegible in dark mode.
- Hidden ads on non-supported platforms.
- Added a settings page where you can choose your ads preferences on Android/iOS.

- Made levels easier (i.e. not impossible)
- Added banner ads
- Added levels
- App now checks your current answers
- Initial release
